name: Notice of Retention Recommendation (K-8)
description: Written advice whether retention is ultimately recommended for a K-8 student, with an offer of a follow-up conference.
deadline: prior to the end of the school year
quote: Prior to the end of the school year, the student’s parent(s)/guardian(s) shall be advised, in writing, if retention is ultimately recommended, and, if so, offer the parent(s)/guardian(s) a follow-up conference to further review the student’s academic progress and to discuss the recommendation for retention.
